business_summary: Shenzhen Increase Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of intelligent high-frequency switching power supplies and related power electronic products in China and internationally. It offers electric vehicle charging power products, such as electric vehicle charging power modules, electric vehicle charging monitoring modules, and electric vehicle charging power systems; and power supply products for power operation, including power operating power supply charging modules, monitoring modules, and power operating power supply systems. The company also provides communication power supplies, electric vehicle on-board power modules, inverter power supplies, and DC lighting products. Its products are applied in new energy vehicles, power, communications, metallurgy, chemical industry, and petroleum, as well as DC lighting and laser equipment fields. The company was founded in 2002 and is based in Shenzhen, China.
